product.title: Dart River Jet Boat and Wilderness Experience

description.text: In Queenstown, this half-day jet-boat safari checks in at the Station Building on Duke Street or at the Glenorchy base on Mull Street, then runs the Dart River into Mount Aspiring National Park. The published format is a wilderness jet rather than a Skippers Canyon road-and-boat combo. The format suits visitors who want a braided-river window without a Lord of the Rings costume stop. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Queenstown, and the itinerary stays on Glenorchy, the Dart River, and Mount Aspiring National Park that define this outing rather than a Walter Peak horse trek.

start.description: Check-in inside the Station Building, Duke Street, Queenstown, 1 hour 15 minutes prior if using return transport, or at 45 Mull Street, Glenorchy if self-driving.

end.description: Return to the Queenstown meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
